how: Voiced locally in a Claude session, no Actions run, 0 credits: kokoro-onnx 0.4.9, onnxruntime 1.20.1 (episode.yml's pins), the hash-pinned Kokoro v1.0 assets (kokoro-v1.0.fp16.onnx f3a290d3..., voices-v1.0.bin bca610b8..., verify_public_voice_asset.ASSETS) through pilot_render.py prepare + voice, each line one segment in its speaker's characters.json voice at speed 1.0. A line is its sentences from the first word's start to the last word's end in timeline.json (the arc-1 method); a voice's pace is its words over its seconds; words are plan_check.words (split on spaces).
calibration: Adam's and Eve's three final arc-1 lines in the same run: 3.798 and 3.566 words/s, the arc-1 measurement's second run to the third decimal (evidence/long/20261026/arc-01-voice.json), so the method and the model are the same.
lines_chosen: Noah: three KJV lines (Genesis 9:25-27) and three short dramatic lines of his warning; the scoffer: six mocking and pleading lines as a Genesis 6-7 Short would give him. 11-16 words each, the talking-line range.

each.line: He says you will not die. He says your eyes will be opened, and you will see.
God hath said, Ye shall not eat of it, neither shall ye touch it, lest ye die.
It was the serpent. He twisted every word. The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.
This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman,
I heard thy voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; and I hid myself.
The woman whom thou gavest to be with me, she gave me of the tree, and I did eat.
The Lord hath commanded it. The flood is coming, and the door is still open.
Come into the ark, all of you. There is room for every one who will turn.
Blessed be the Lord God of Shem; and Canaan shall be his servant.
I have built this ark for a hundred years. Every board is a warning to you.
Cursed be Canaan; a servant of servants shall he be unto his brethren.
God shall enlarge Japheth, and he shall dwell in the tents of Shem.
Rain? Look up, old man. There has never been a cloud like that in your sky.
A boat in the middle of dry land! Noah, you have lost your mind.
Where is your flood? We eat, we drink, we marry, and nothing ever changes.
Your God is late again. Go on, preach to the animals; they will listen.
Open the door, Noah! The water is rising! Open the door!
We laughed at you for years. Let us in. Please, let us in.

used_by: migration/production/bible/voice_pace.py VOICE_PACE noah 2.970, scoffer 3.425 (plan_check and long_plan_check). Adam and Eve keep the arc-1 first run's 3.975 and 3.732 (the faster: a line is judged from that pace to SLOW_RATIO of it).
reading: Noah (bm_george) speaks near the narrator (2.97 vs 2.874); the scoffer (am_puck) ~19 % faster than the narrator. At plan_check.WPS 2.75 a 12-word scoffer line estimated 4.36 s would measure ~3.50 s, inside the 4 s clip only by the retime.
